description: Run an Object > Slice command: make (object-based slices from the targets), release, create_from_selection, create_from_guides, duplicate, combine, clip_to_artboard (toggle), delete_all; or View > Show / Hide Slices (toggle_visibility) and Lock Slices (toggle_lock). create_region makes a slice over a rectangle, as dragging the Slice Tool does

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

target.description: Select these items first. make, release, create_from_selection, duplicate and combine act on the selection

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

x.description: create_region: left edge, points from the artboard's left

y.description: create_region: top edge, points from the artboard's top

name: edit_slices
title: Edit Slices
